invariants.rationale: The result object is returned and should not be null as the method does not support partition deletion but returns metadata.

meta.value: result is non-null on method exit

invariants.rationale: The input context parameter must be non-null for the operation to begin.
The instantTime parameter must not be null as it represents the commit time.
The partitions list parameter must not be null for the method to proceed.
The size of partitions list cannot be negative and should be zero or more.
